chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, said:
No person who practices moderation becomes impoverished.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan; the kunyah of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام
key_terms.اقْتِصَادٍ: moderation; balanced and restrained conduct, especially in expenditure
key_terms.قَالَ: said; introducing the statement of the Imam
key_terms.مَا عَالَ: did not become poor; did not fall into need
key_terms.مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ: Musa ibn Ja'far; the Imam being quoted

ai.seo_question: How does moderation in spending protect a person from poverty in Islamic teachings?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that moderation and balanced spending protect a person from poverty. It highlights prudent conduct in managing one's affairs as a moral and practical virtue.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1720 - Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"A person who practices moderation will never face poverty.
